rows.title: Attachment View
rows.help: How pictures and files show in the composer and in sent messages. Inline puts each one in the text where you added it; Strip shows them in a row. The message and its order stay the same.

rows.title: Edited Files Card
rows.help: The card that lists a turn's edited files, with Undo and View changes.

rows.title: Web Images in Replies
rows.help: A web image loads from its site, which then sees that you read the reply.

rows.title: Files Outside the Project
rows.help: What a file link in a reply does when the file is outside the chat's folders. Keys and .env files never open.

rows.title: Needs You
rows.help: A badge in the chat header counts what your agents wait on; a click lists every ask with its answers. New agent tabs.

rows.title: Start New Chats In
rows.help: Where a new chat runs. Cloud starts it on your own Cloud machine, with your project copied there. The new chat's composer can change it for that chat.

rows.title: Scroll to Bottom When I Send
rows.help: When off, sending while you are reading up keeps your place and shows new messages below.

rows.title: Show Context Usage
rows.help: The ring beside the model that fills as the chat uses its context window.

rows.title: Show Dictation Button
rows.help: The microphone beside Send in every composer, including the New Tab page.

rows.title: Show Machine Load Warnings
rows.help: Shows a warning when a remote machine is at its CPU or memory budget in the Computer menu.

rows.title: Check Spelling While Typing
rows.help: Underlines misspellings and offers system suggestions in the composer.

rows.title: Agent Chat Zoom
rows.help: The display size for agent chat. Cmd-0 resets it.

rows.title: Discover Chat Folders
rows.help: Find harness chat folders automatically. When off, only the listed folders are used.

rows.title: Enable Chats
rows.help: Show chats stored on this device. Nothing is uploaded.

rows.title: Chat Folders
rows.help: Add absolute paths to harness data folders. Protected folders are refused. Your organization can add locked folders.

rows.title: Permission Mode for New Chats
rows.help: What a new chat may do without asking. A mode you pick in a chat applies to that chat only.

rows.title: cmux Model Router Model
rows.help: The model a new chat on the cmux model router starts on. A model you pick in a chat applies to that chat only.

rows.title: Let Sessions Answer Their Sub-sessions' Questions
rows.help: When an agent in a sub-session asks a question, the session that started it can answer, and the answer shows who gave it. Permission requests always wait for you. Off: only you answer.

rows.title: Let Agents Start Sub-sessions
rows.help: An agent can start other agent sessions to work on parts of a task in parallel. They show under its session in the sidebar.

rows.title: Open Sub-sessions per Session
rows.help: The most live sub-sessions one session can have at the same time. Running, waiting and harness-alive children count; finished, dead and closed children do not use a slot.

rows.title: Deepest Nesting
rows.help: How many levels of sub-sessions can start under a session. 1 lets a session start sub-sessions that cannot start their own.

rows.title: Running Sub-sessions per Session
rows.help: The most sub-sessions one session runs at the same time. More wait their turn and start as running ones finish. Running ones are never stopped when you lower it.

rows.title: Trust My Own Folders Without Asking
rows.help: Agents start in folders under your project roots, and in repositories owned by your organizations, without asking. Other folders ask first.

rows.title: Trusted GitHub Owners
rows.help: A repository is trusted when all of its GitHub remotes belong to these users or organizations.

rows.title: Trusted Project Roots
rows.help: Everything inside these folders is trusted. Use full paths or ~/ paths.

rows.title: Show Announcements
rows.help: Short cards from the cmux team above Settings, shown when the pointer is over the sidebar.

rows.title: Download Announcements
rows.help: Off: cmux never asks the network for announcements. The request carries no identifiers.

rows.title: Global Hot Key
rows.help: Show/Hide All Windows (⌃⌥⌘.) works while another app is in front.

rows.title: Hide Dock Icon When No Windows Are Open
rows.help: cmux keeps running in the menu bar, out of the Dock and the app switcher, until a window opens.

rows.title: When Quitting
rows.help: Terminals run in cmux-tui and keep running after cmux quits unless you end them.

rows.title: Show Menu Bar Icon
rows.help: A cmux item in the menu bar: open cmux, your account, working agents, help, Discord, updates, logs and Quit.

rows.title: Start Agent from Any App
rows.help: Start Agent (⌃⌥⌘Space) works while another app is in front. Change its key in Keyboard Shortcuts.

rows.title: Warn Before Closing a Working Agent
Warn Before Closing a Running Program
Tab Text Size
rows.help: Text size of tab titles. Unset, tabs follow the interface size.

rows.title: Maximum Tab Width
rows.help: Widest a tab gets when the strip has room.

rows.title: Minimum Selected Tab Width
rows.help: When the strip is crowded, every tab shrinks evenly to this width, and the selected tab stays at least this wide.

rows.title: Minimum Tab Width
rows.help: Narrowest the other tabs get before the strip scrolls. Never wider than the selected tab's minimum.

rows.title: Pinned Tab Width
rows.help: Width of a pinned tab.

rows.title: Tab Bar Height
rows.help: Height of a pane's tab bar. Its tabs grow and shrink with it.

rows.title: Browser Toolbar Position
rows.help: Where the address bar row of browser and Markdown panes sits. At the bottom, its suggestions and menus open upward.

rows.title: Computer Use Driver
rows.help: Legacy runs the current cmux Computer Use helper. Upstream runs the new helper built on the upstream Cua Driver; macOS asks for its permissions separately.

rows.title: Computer Use
rows.help: Lets agents see and use your apps through the signed cmux Computer Use helper. macOS asks for Accessibility and Screen Recording when you first allow them.

rows.title: Live Preview in Chat
rows.help: While an agent uses an app, its chat shows a small live view of that app. Click the view to open Agent Activity.

rows.title: Text Editor
rows.help: The app Open in Text Editor uses for a path: an app name, a bundle ID or the path of an app. Empty uses the app that opens source code.

rows.title: Free AI Model Without Sign-In
rows.help: Lets agents use the free cmux AI model while you are signed out. The first time an agent uses it, cmux proves to the Cloud service that this is a real Mac. Sign in for more models and higher limits.

rows.title: Keep Recently Closed Items For
rows.help: Each machine deletes closed items that are older. 0 keeps them however old they are.

rows.title: Recently Closed Items to Keep
rows.help: Each machine deletes its oldest closed tabs, screens, workspaces and windows past this many. 0 keeps them all.

rows.title: Keep Terminal Commands For
rows.help: Each machine deletes recorded commands that are older.

rows.title: Record Terminal Commands
rows.help: Lists finished shell commands in History. Command lines can contain secrets.

rows.title: Focus After Closing a Pane
rows.help: Which pane gets focus when the focused pane closes.

rows.title: Column Width Presets
rows.help: Widths a column cycles through, as fractions of the visible strip width.

rows.title: Fixed Column Width
rows.help: A share of the window width, for Fixed Width new columns.

rows.title: Focus Follows Mouse
rows.help: Moving the pointer onto a pane or scrolling over it focuses that pane. Off keeps focus where you type until you click. Momentum and the first second after typing never move focus.

rows.title: Open Links and Files
rows.help: Where a link or file you open from a terminal, an agent chat, Home or a page appears. Split Right uses the pane on the right, or makes one.

rows.title: Main Pane
rows.help: Agent Chats keeps an agent chat as the main pane: links, files, subagents and side chats it opens appear as tabs in a column on its right, and closing that column gives the chat its full width back.

rows.title: New Terminals and Browsers
rows.help: Open a Tab adds a tab to the focused pane. Split Automatically splits the largest pane, like New Pane (Auto Layout).

rows.title: Web Pages Get Command + Scroll First
rows.help: A web page that uses Command + Scroll itself, such as Figma or Excalidraw zooming, keeps it. Over any other page, Command + Scroll moves columns. Off, Command + Scroll always moves columns.

rows.title: Rows
rows.help: Off hides New Row and fits a column's existing rows into it without scrolling.

rows.title: Scroll Areas
rows.help: Side-by-side panes that do not fit scroll sideways instead of shrinking, also in docked columns.

rows.title: Scroll Columns and Rows With
rows.help: Command + Scroll moves columns and rows from anywhere, and a plain scroll always scrolls the pane under the pointer. Without a modifier, a sideways scroll moves columns unless the pane scrolls sideways itself, and rows scroll only over the gaps between them.

rows.title: Split Sizing
rows.help: Even gives every pane in the column the same size after a split.

rows.title: Strip Margin
rows.help: Space between the window edge and the columns.

rows.title: Column Scroll Bar
rows.help: A thin bar under the columns that shows and moves the visible range.

rows.title: Split for Browsers Too
rows.help: With Split Automatically, new browsers also get their own pane instead of a tab.

rows.title: Back and Forward Steps
rows.help: Workspaces: Go Back and Go Forward move between workspaces and top pages, and return to the tab each one last had focused. Everything: they also step through tabs and panes inside a workspace.

rows.title: Back and Forward
rows.help: What Go Back and Go Forward walk: places in this workspace, in this window, or the focused page's own history.

rows.title: New Terminal Opens a Workspace
rows.help: Create a new workspace in the current space instead of a tab. Hold Option to reverse this for one click.

rows.title: Commands Prefix
rows.help: Typed into an empty query, this character enters the scope. A prefix you assign moves from any other scope.

rows.title: Scope List Prefix
rows.help: Typed into an empty query, this character enters the scope. A prefix you assign moves from any other scope.

rows.title: Settings Prefix
rows.help: Typed into an empty query, this character enters the scope. A prefix you assign moves from any other scope.

rows.title: Tabs Prefix
rows.help: Typed into an empty query, this character enters the scope. A prefix you assign moves from any other scope.

rows.title: Workspaces Prefix
rows.help: Typed into an empty query, this character enters the scope. A prefix you assign moves from any other scope.

rows.title: Pinned Folders
rows.help: The picker lists these folders under Locations, after Home and Downloads. Use full paths or ~/ paths.

rows.title: Find Screenshot Apps
rows.help: The Screenshots pane also shows the folders of screenshot apps it finds, such as CleanShot X, Shottr and Kap.

rows.title: More Screenshot Folders
rows.help: The Screenshots pane also shows the pictures and videos in these folders. Use full paths or ~/ paths.

rows.title: Allow Full-Access Modes
rows.help: Off, cmux won't switch an agent into a mode that skips approvals.

rows.title: Keep Mac Awake While Agents Work
rows.help: Stops idle sleep while an agent on this Mac is working. Your display can still turn off, and closing the lid still puts the Mac to sleep.

rows.title: Suggest Follow-Up Tasks
rows.help: Agents can suggest next tasks, which you start as child chats beside the current one. Agents started after the change get it.

rows.title: Resume Agents After Restart
rows.help: Terminal agents reopen their session after a crash or restart.

rows.title: Group Workspaces by Computer
rows.help: Off: one list of workspaces, and a workspace on another computer names it under its title. On: a section per computer.

rows.title: Workspace Icons
rows.help: An icon for each workspace title. "*" sets the icon of every other workspace; an empty icon hides it.

rows.title: Tab Bar and Browser Toolbar
rows.help: In a browser pane with the tab bar and the address bar on the same edge: the tab bar above the address bar, or below it.

rows.title: Tab Bar Position
rows.help: Where each pane's tab bar sits. At the bottom, the panes reach the top of the window; the window buttons never cover a pane.

rows.title: Cmd-W Closes Pinned Tabs
rows.help: When off, Cmd-W on a pinned tab selects the next tab and keeps the pinned tab. Close a pinned tab from its menu.

rows.title: Native New Tab Page
rows.help: Cmd-T and the + button open the native New Tab page instead of the web one. It opens faster and lists every command palette action as you type. Recent chats and widgets are only on the web page for now.

rows.title: Show Now Playing on New Tab
rows.help: A player for what is playing, on the New Tab page.

rows.title: New Tab Position
rows.help: Where Cmd-T and the + button put the new tab. New Tab to the Right in a tab's menu always puts it after that tab.

rows.title: New Tab Template
rows.help: The layout of the New Tab page. Terminal skips the page and opens a terminal. The dots at the bottom of the page also change it.

rows.title: Show Quick Actions on New Tab
rows.help: Chats that need you, and New Terminal, New Browser Tab and New Chat.

rows.title: Show Recent Chats on New Tab
rows.help: Your recent chats under the composer. The palette finds any chat.

rows.title: Show Clock on New Tab
rows.help: A quiet local time display beside the composer.

rows.title: Ask What to Work On on New Tab
rows.help: A headline over the composer that asks what to work on, with the project as a picker.

rows.title: Show Machines on New Tab
rows.help: Your machines and whether each is online.

rows.title: New Tab Widget Order
rows.help: The order of the widgets on New Tab. Right-click New Tab and choose Edit New Tab to drag them.

rows.title: Show Projects on New Tab
rows.help: A card of this Mac and its recent projects over the composer.

rows.title: Show Quote of the Day on New Tab
rows.help: A bundled public-domain quote, changing daily.

rows.title: Show Template Dots on New Tab
rows.help: Dots under the page that switch its template.

rows.title: Show Stopwatch on New Tab
rows.help: A small elapsed-time stopwatch beside the composer.

rows.title: Show Warm Greeting on New Tab
rows.help: A time-of-day greeting such as Good afternoon.

rows.title: Show Weather on New Tab
rows.help: The current weather and today's high and low, for the city below or your time zone's city.

rows.title: Weather City
rows.help: A city for the weather widget. Empty uses your time zone's city.

rows.title: Tab Overflow
rows.help: Shrink narrows every tab to the minimum width before the strip scrolls. Scroll keeps tabs wide and scrolls sooner.

rows.title: New Tab Button
rows.help: On Hover shows each tab bar's + only while the pointer is over that tab bar.

rows.title: Swap Cmd-T and Cmd-N
rows.help: When on, Cmd-T opens a workspace in the current group and Cmd-N opens a tab. When off, Cmd-T opens a tab, or a workspace when an agent chat or a pane without tabs is focused.

rows.title: Tasks Layout
rows.help: Inbox lists what needs you first, with the task beside it. Changes apply at once.

rows.title: Update Channel
rows.help: Canary and Dev get builds before they reach Nightly. Stable gets only builds that have run a week without problems, so switching to it may mean no updates for a while.

rows.title: Download Updates Automatically
rows.help: Off: cmux checks for updates and asks before it downloads one. On: updates download by themselves. Either way, cmux asks before it restarts into an update.

rows.title: Install Within
rows.help: A downloaded nightly installs by itself once agents and commands finish and you stop typing, and never waits longer than this. Terminals and agents carry on after the restart.

rows.title: Quiet Time Before Installing
rows.help: How long the keyboard and mouse must be idle before a downloaded nightly installs by itself.

rows.title: Install Updates When Quitting
rows.help: A downloaded update installs as cmux quits. Terminals keep running.

rows.title: Keep Previous Versions
rows.help: Earlier builds kept so you can roll back. Uses almost no disk until files change.

rows.title: On Metered Networks
rows.help: While downloads wait, a found update shows on Settings and one click downloads it.

rows.title: Show Feature Tips
rows.help: Now and then, a small tip points at a feature an update added. Close it or use the feature and it never comes back.

rows.title: Show What's New After Updates
rows.help: After an update, a card at the bottom of the sidebar links to What's New until you open or dismiss it.

rows.title: Web UI Updates
rows.help: Every Merge: changes to the web UI arrive minutes after they land, without waiting for the next app update. Off: the web UI this app shipped with.

rows.title: Titlebar
rows.help: Minimal has no titlebar strip; the top row moves the window.

rows.title: Titlebar Buttons
rows.help: With the sidebar hidden, On Hover hides the sidebar button, Back and Forward until the pointer is over the top row. With the sidebar open, they always show.

rows.title: Idle For
rows.help: A workspace counts as idle when you have not opened it and nothing in it changed for this many days. Pinned workspaces, running commands and workspaces that need you never archive.

rows.title: Idle Workspaces
rows.help: What cmux does with workspaces you have not used for a while. Archived workspaces stay in their group, dimmed and last, and come back when you open them.

rows.title: Name Workspaces from Tabs
rows.help: A workspace you have not named shows its front tab's name: a page's title, an agent chat's title, or a terminal's title or folder. Your own name always wins.

rows.title: Hibernate Idle Workspaces
rows.help: Frees the memory of workspaces you have not used for a while. Terminals and agents keep running; pages and chats come back where they were when you open the workspace.

rows.title: Hibernate Hidden Spaces After
rows.help: When no window shows a space, its workspaces hibernate after this many idle minutes instead. Pinned workspaces, running commands and agents, and workspaces kept awake never hibernate.

rows.title: Hibernate After
rows.help: A workspace hibernates when you have not opened it and nothing in it changed for this many minutes. Pinned workspaces, running commands and agents, and workspaces kept awake never hibernate.

rows.title: New Workspace Position
rows.help: Where Cmd-N, the + button and the CLI put a new workspace in the sidebar. A workspace made in a group goes to the same place inside that group. Pinned workspaces stay above it.

rows.title: Chat Code Font
rows.help: The font of code in the chat. Empty uses the Markdown viewer's code font, then the terminal font.

rows.title: Chat Code Size
rows.help: Code as a share of the chat's text size. Empty uses the Markdown viewer's.

rows.title: Session Info Chip
rows.help: Left puts it in a row below the tab row; Right keeps it in the header (or leads the tab-row tools); Off hides it.

rows.title: Chat Full Width
rows.help: The chat fills the whole pane instead of the text width.

rows.title: Session Info
rows.help: Where the Session Info panel opens at the right of the chat. Push narrows the chat beside it; Overlay lies over the chat.

rows.title: Chat Minimap
rows.help: What runs down the chat's edge: the rail, one tick per prompt; the full map, every message at its place with a box for what is on screen; or nothing.

rows.title: Prompt Rail Side
rows.help: The edge of the chat the prompt rail sits on, one tick per prompt. Right-click the rail to move it.

rows.title: Transcript View
rows.help: How much of each turn a chat shows. Normal folds thinking and tool output; Thinking opens thinking; Verbose also opens tool output. A chat's ··· menu changes its own view.

rows.title: VS Code Minimap
rows.help: A small picture of the whole chat at its right edge, as in VS Code. Click or drag it to scroll.

rows.title: Chat Text Width
rows.help: The widest the chat's column gets. On a wider pane the chat stays centered.

rows.title: Accent
rows.help: The color of selection, focus and the Send button. Theme Color takes the theme's own hue, such as Rose Pine's iris.

rows.title: App Theme
rows.help: Colors for the window, sidebar, tabs and cmux's pages. Terminals keep the Terminal Theme. Every color meets WCAG AA contrast.

rows.title: Background
rows.help: Choose a public-domain painting, your desktop wallpaper, or a macOS system wallpaper behind the window material.

rows.title: Material
rows.help: Unset, the window follows Ghostty's background-opacity and background-blur.

rows.title: Opacity
rows.help: How much of the theme color covers the material behind the window.

rows.title: Change Picture
rows.help: How often a shuffled background turns to its next picture.

rows.title: Borders
rows.help: None removes every border, hairline and separator in the app.

rows.title: Window Style
rows.help: The look of the window: whether panes sit in one rounded card, and where lines are drawn. Separation, Sidebar Background and the sidebar border still win when you set them.

rows.title: Bezier X1
rows.help: A control point of the Custom (Bezier) curve, as in CSS cubic-bezier().

rows.title: Bezier X2
rows.help: A control point of the Custom (Bezier) curve, as in CSS cubic-bezier().

rows.title: Bezier Y1
rows.help: A control point of the Custom (Bezier) curve, as in CSS cubic-bezier().

rows.title: Bezier Y2
rows.help: A control point of the Custom (Bezier) curve, as in CSS cubic-bezier().

rows.title: Color Blend Space
rows.help: OKLab blends with even lightness. sRGB mixes the red, green and blue channels.

rows.title: Color Change Curve
rows.help: How a color change moves over its duration. Spring uses Spring Response and Spring Damping; Custom uses the four Bezier values.

rows.title: Color Change Duration
rows.help: How long a color change takes. 0 changes colors at once.

rows.title: Animate Color Changes
rows.help: Workspace, theme and color changes blend from the old colors to the new ones. Off: they change at once.

rows.title: With Reduce Motion
rows.help: What color changes do while Reduce Motion is on in macOS.

rows.title: Spring Damping
rows.help: 1 arrives smoothly with no overshoot. Above 1 is slower; below 1 arrives sooner.

rows.title: Spring Response
rows.help: Seconds a spring color change takes to reach its new colors.

rows.title: Density
rows.help: Row height, padding, corners, icons and text size together. Compact is the default.

rows.title: Experimental Appearance Controls
rows.help: Applies Hue and Saturation to the window's tint. Off, they have no effect.

rows.title: Focused Pane
rows.help: How the focused pane stands out: its border, subtler tabs in the other panes, both or neither.

rows.title: Highlight Color
rows.help: The color of selected text everywhere: terminals, Markdown, editors, the address bar and text fields. Unset, it is the terminal theme's selection color.

rows.title: Hue
rows.help: Shift the tint color around the hue wheel.

rows.title: Dim Inactive Windows
rows.help: How much more theme color covers a window while another one is in front. 0 keeps the same look.

rows.title: Interface Size
rows.help: Text size of tabs, the sidebar and other controls. Terminal text has its own size.

rows.title: Pane Backgrounds
rows.help: One background behind the whole window, or a copy in each pane. A pane's own background (right-click a pane) shows either way.

rows.title: Saturation
rows.help: Increase or reduce the tint color intensity.

rows.title: Sidebar Background
rows.help: Same as Main Pane gives the sidebar the main pane's background. Separate shades the sidebar darker than the main pane.

rows.title: Status Indicators
rows.help: Static draws a still, distinct shape for each state. Reduce Motion always uses Static.

rows.title: Let Statuses Choose Their Style
rows.help: A status that asks for a style (cmux status set --style) uses it.

rows.title: Show Agent Working on Tabs
rows.help: Three dots take the tab's icon place while an agent works.

rows.title: Show Page Loading on Tabs
rows.help: A spinner takes a browser tab's icon place while its page loads.

rows.title: Style
rows.help: How sidebar rows, tabs and panes show work in progress.

rows.title: Theme
rows.help: Colors for terminals. cmux uses them too while App Theme is Match Terminal Theme. A space, workspace or terminal theme overrides it.

rows.title: Theme Edits
rows.help: Your color changes to a theme, such as "Rose Pine/background": "#1f1d2e". The theme itself never changes; remove an entry to reset that color.

rows.title: Tint with Desktop Wallpaper
rows.help: The glass takes the colors of your desktop picture and follows it when the picture or Space changes.

rows.title: Stage All and Revert All Bar
Unfocused Pane Tabs
rows.help: How the other panes' tabs draw subtler when Focused Pane marks tabs: Fade dims them, Tonal steps their text down, Quiet keeps only a faint selected pill.

rows.title: Separation
rows.help: How panes are told apart. None draws no border or divider at all; dragging between panes still resizes them. Default: dividers inside the curved main pane, borders otherwise.

rows.title: Code Font
rows.help: The font of code blocks and inline code. Empty uses the terminal font. The agent chat uses it too unless it has its own.

rows.title: Code Font Size
rows.help: Code as a share of the text size. A monospaced font looks bigger than the text font at the same size, so code is a little smaller by default.

rows.title: Default Font Size
rows.help: The text size every markdown viewer opens at. Cmd-= and Cmd-- change it in one viewer; Cmd-0 goes back to this size.

rows.title: Full Width
rows.help: Text fills the whole pane instead of the text width.

rows.title: Text Width
rows.help: The widest a line of text gets, in characters (30 to 1000). On a wider window the text stays centered with margins. Wide tables and code scroll sideways in their own box.

rows.title: Load Web Images Automatically
rows.help: Web image sites can see your address and when you open a document. When off, each document asks before loading its web images.

rows.title: Paragraph Spacing
rows.help: The gap after each paragraph, as a share of the text size.

rows.title: Border
rows.help: A line on the sidebar's edge. Off, the edge shows a line only while you hover or drag it.

rows.title: Bottom Sections Height
rows.help: The share of the sidebar the bottom sections fill before they scroll.

rows.title: Show Tips
rows.help: A "Did you know" card above the account button shows one cmux feature a day that you have not used yet. Each tip shows only once.

rows.title: Command-9
rows.help: Goes to the last item, as in browsers, or to the ninth.

rows.title: Show Sidebar Controls Only on Hover
rows.help: The sidebar's New Workspace button, spaces, profile button and Search button, and the sidebar button, Back and Forward above it, show only while the pointer is over the sidebar. Off, they always show.

rows.title: Sidebar Density
rows.help: Comfortable rows keep one line on taller rows with more space around them. Expanded rows show each workspace's status or folder under its name, how long ago it changed, and its pull request and computer.

rows.title: Detailed Status Icons
rows.help: Workspace rows show a separate icon for working, waiting for input, error and done. Off, a row shows a spinner while it works and a blue dot when it is ready for you.

rows.title: Show Group Member Count
rows.help: A collapsed group shows how many workspaces it holds after its name. Off, it shows only its loading spinner.

rows.title: Show Group Unread Count
rows.help: A collapsed group shows how many unread notifications its workspaces have. Off, it shows only its loading spinner.

rows.title: Hover Card Delay
rows.help: How long the pointer rests on a workspace or a tab before its card opens. While a card shows, the next one opens at once.

rows.title: Show Hover Cards
rows.help: A card with details opens when the pointer rests on a workspace or a tab.

rows.title: Group Card Delay
rows.help: How long the pointer rests on a group before its summary card opens.

rows.title: Group Card Members
rows.help: The most members a group's card lists by name.

rows.title: Group Card Leads With
rows.help: Which part of a group's card comes first.

rows.title: Group Card: Latest Activity
rows.help: Show the member that changed last, and when.

rows.title: Group Card: Branches
rows.help: Show the members' git branches.

rows.title: Group Card: Members
rows.help: Show the member count and the members' names.

rows.title: Group Card: Ports
rows.help: Show the members' listening ports.

rows.title: Group Card: Status
rows.help: Show how many members work, wait, failed or have unread items.

rows.title: Cards on Tab Groups
rows.help: A summary card opens when the pointer rests on a tab group's chip.

rows.title: Cards on Workspace Groups
rows.help: A summary card opens when the pointer rests on a workspace group's header.

rows.title: Workspace Card Layout
rows.help: What a workspace's hover card shows: its history of prompts and waits, its details, or both.

rows.title: Workspace Card History Lines
rows.help: The most prompts, waits and finished turns a workspace's card lists. The list scrolls.

rows.title: Show Branch in Workspace Cards
rows.help: The workspace's branch and pull request.

rows.title: Show Ports in Workspace Cards
rows.help: The ports the workspace listens on.

rows.title: Show Prompts in Workspace Cards
rows.help: Each prompt you sent and when, in the card's history.

rows.title: Show Running Times in Workspace Cards
rows.help: How long the workspace has worked or waited, and how long its command has run.

rows.title: Show Waits in Workspace Cards
rows.help: When an agent waited for your input or finished its turn, in the card's history.

rows.title: Minimal Mode
rows.help: Workspace rows show only their icon, name and unread mark, and section titles become thin lines.

rows.title: Hide Bands Until Hover
rows.help: Hides the chosen sections until the pointer is over the sidebar.

rows.title: Show Whole Sidebar Without Fade
rows.help: The sidebar's edges stop fading and the whole list shows. It also hides the bottom profile and search bar. Off, the edges fade and the bar shows.

rows.title: Show Now Playing
rows.help: A player for what is playing, at the bottom of the sidebar.

rows.title: Include Other Apps in Now Playing
rows.help: Also show what plays in other apps, such as Spotify, Music or another browser. Off: only what plays in cmux.

rows.title: Command-Number Shortcuts
rows.help: Every item: Home is Command-1, the App Store Command-2, the first workspace Command-3. Workspaces only: the first workspace is Command-1.

rows.title: Scroll Tall Sections
rows.help: Off: the top and bottom sections never scroll and the workspace list gets smaller.

rows.title: Priority View
rows.help: A bell at the top of the sidebar shows every agent chat on every machine, the ones waiting on you first, then finished, failed, working and idle.

rows.title: Show Priority View
rows.help: The sidebar bell's state while the Priority view is on. Off, the sidebar is unchanged.

rows.title: Section Look
rows.help: How the sections above and below the workspace list draw.

rows.title: Session Tree
rows.help: Lists a workspace that another workspace's agent started under it, and shows each row's pull requests and the first rows' Command-number keys.

rows.title: Show All Chats on New Tab
rows.help: On the New Tab page, the Threads and Console styles list every coding agent chat on this computer, newest first. Off, they show the recent chats only.

rows.title: Show Workspace Colors
rows.help: Workspaces and groups draw their colors in the sidebar. Off, the sidebar draws no colors and keeps the colors you set.

rows.title: Mark This Mac's Workspaces
rows.help: With workspaces on more than one computer, a workspace on another computer shows that computer's icon in its color. On, this Mac's workspaces show its icon too.

rows.title: Show New Workspace Menu Button
rows.help: A chevron beside the + in the sidebar's titlebar opens the New Workspace menu. Off, right-click the + for the same menu.

rows.title: Show Search Button
rows.help: A magnifying glass after the profile button searches workspaces, tabs, history, agent chats, settings and commands. Off, Search stays in the command palette.

rows.title: Show Timestamps
rows.help: Workspace rows show when they last changed: a time today, else an age such as 3d. Off, rows show no times; the hover card still does.

rows.title: Sidebar Side
rows.help: The window edge the sidebar sits on. On the right, the window buttons sit over the tab bar.

rows.title: Spaces Position
rows.help: Where the spaces dots sit in the sidebar: under the window buttons or above the Settings row.

rows.title: Show Spaces
rows.help: Always keeps the spaces shown, also when the sidebar's controls show only on hover. On Hover lets them hide with the other controls then.

rows.title: Next and Previous Item
rows.help: What Command-Control-] and Command-Control-[ step through.

rows.title: Wrap Around
rows.help: Past the last item, the next item is the first again.

rows.title: Sidebar Style
rows.help: Rail shrinks the sidebar to a thin strip with a mark for each workspace. Point at the strip to open the full sidebar over your work.

rows.title: Sidebar Text Size
rows.help: Makes the sidebar's names, headers, icons and rows larger together. Larger matches the ChatGPT app's sidebar.

rows.title: Top Sections Height
rows.help: The share of the sidebar the top sections fill before they scroll.

rows.title: Agent Status
rows.help: The status agents and hooks report, one line each.

rows.title: Icon
rows.help: The icon or emoji you chose for a workspace.

rows.title: Log
rows.help: The newest line agents and scripts log: cmux workspace log append <text>.

rows.title: Latest Notification
rows.help: The text of the workspace's newest unread notification.

rows.title: Ports
rows.help: Set by a hook: cmux workspace status set ports <text>.

rows.title: Running Program
rows.help: The terminal's title, which the shell or program sets.

rows.title: Progress
rows.help: A progress bar under the row and the busy mark of running work.

rows.title: Pull Request
rows.help: Set by a hook: cmux workspace status set pr <text>.

rows.title: Second Line Order
rows.help: The order of the shown items under the workspace name.

rows.title: Agent Working
rows.help: A mark while an agent works in the workspace.

rows.title: Show Running Commands
rows.help: A shell command that runs a while shows as busy.

rows.title: Command-1 to 9 Select
rows.help: Workspaces: Command-1 to 9 go to sidebar items and Control-1 to 9 to tabs. Tabs: Command-1 to 9 go to the focused pane's tabs and Control-1 to 9 to workspaces.

rows.title: Animation Bounce
rows.help: None stops tabs, rows and panes exactly at their place. Subtle lets them settle with a small bounce.

rows.title: Animate the Agent Cursor
rows.help: The agent cursor glides between points and shows click ripples. Off: it jumps and shows no ripple.

rows.title: Play Animations
rows.help: Off turns every animation in cmux off: rows, tabs, panes, menus, cards, the agent cursor, spinners and cmux web pages change at once. On, the switches below choose area by area.

rows.title: Animate Highlights and Colors
rows.help: Hover and press highlights, focus fades and theme color changes ease in. Off: they change at once.

rows.title: Animate Home and Chats
rows.help: The Chief chat, its bubbles, the composer and the Home list move and fade. Off: they change at once.

rows.title: Animate Hover Cards
rows.help: Hover cards and tooltips fade and slide in. Off: they show and hide at once.

rows.title: Animate Spinners and Progress
rows.help: Spinners turn, status dots pulse and attention flashes blink. Off: they show a still glyph.

rows.title: Animate New Tabs
rows.help: A new tab grows into its place in the tab bar. Off shows it there at once.

rows.title: Animate New Workspaces
rows.help: A new workspace row opens in the sidebar. Off shows it there at once.

rows.title: Animate Menus and Cards
rows.help: Menus, popovers, the command palette, sheets, toasts, notices, find bars and cards fade and slide in and out. Off: they show and hide at once.

rows.title: Animate Panes and Windows
rows.help: Splits, closes, zooms, dividers, focus rings, drop zones and windows open, close and move with motion. Off: they change at once.

rows.title: Animate the Sidebar
rows.help: Rows and groups slide when they reorder, open, close, pin or move to the top, and the sidebar slides when it shows or hides. Off: they change at once.

rows.title: Animate Tabs
rows.help: Tabs grow, shrink and slide when they open, close, reorder or collapse into a group. Off: the tab bar changes at once.

rows.title: Animate cmux Web Pages
rows.help: Transitions and animations in cmux's own pages, such as agent chats, New Tab and Markdown. Off: they end at once. Websites are not changed.

rows.title: Calm Mode
rows.help: Calm: nothing slides, springs or spins, hover cards stay closed and the pointer leaves no highlight on tabs, rows and buttons. Still: Calm, and every animation is instant. Your other motion and hover card settings come back when it is off.

rows.title: Animate Panes
rows.help: Splits, closes, moves, zooms, column scrolls and screen switches slide into place. Off: they change at once.

rows.title: Plain Backgrounds
rows.help: Draws windows in the plain theme color, without paintings, wallpapers or glass. Your background choices stay as they are and come back when you turn it off.

rows.title: Traffic Light Clearance
rows.help: Space kept free for the window's close, minimize and zoom buttons.

rows.title: Workspace Color Style
rows.help: How a workspace's color shows in the sidebar: a dot before its name, a bar down the row's edge, or the whole row filled with the color.

rows.title: Font Family
rows.help: A monospaced font installed on this Mac.

rows.title: Open Program Links In
rows.help: Where a URL goes when a program in a terminal opens a browser, such as aws login or gh auth login: cmux, system, chrome, safari, arc, firefox, edge, brave, app:<name>, a profile after @ (chrome@Profile 1), or command:<command> to let your script decide. A BROWSER you set yourself wins.

rows.title: Program Link Rules
rows.help: Checked in order before the default; the first match wins. Write <match> -> <target>: caller:aws matches the program that opened the URL, and text, * wildcards or re: match the URL. Example: caller:gh github.com -> safari

rows.title: Detect Indentation
rows.help: Tab size and spaces follow the file's own indentation.

rows.title: Copy the Line When Nothing Is Selected
Font Family
rows.help: Empty uses the terminal font.

rows.title: Font Size
rows.help: Empty uses the terminal font size. Cmd-= and Cmd-- change it in one editor.

rows.title: Format on Save
rows.help: Runs the language's formatter when one is installed.

rows.title: Take Defaults From
rows.help: cmux reads that editor's settings and keybindings files and never changes them. A setting you make here wins.

rows.title: End Files with a Newline on Save
Insert Spaces
rows.help: Tab inserts spaces. Off inserts a tab character.

rows.title: Line Height
rows.help: 0 computes it from the font size. A value under 8 multiplies the font size.

rows.title: Zoom with Command and the Scroll Wheel
Add a Cursor With
rows.help: The key you hold while you click to add a cursor.

rows.title: Rulers
rows.help: Columns where a vertical line shows.

rows.title: Sticky Scroll
rows.help: The lines that open the scopes around the top line stay at the top while you scroll.

rows.title: Word Wrap
rows.help: Opt-Z turns it on and off.

rows.title: Longest Agent Pointer Move
rows.help: The longest time one agent pointer move takes with human motion. Short moves take less.

rows.title: Agent Pointer Motion
rows.help: How an agent moves the pointer in browser tabs. Human moves along a curved path and rests before each click, as a person does, so pages see hover and timing like a person's. Instant jumps to the target and clicks at once.

rows.title: Built-in uBlock Origin
rows.help: The full uBlock Origin blocks ads and trackers in Chromium tabs. Takes effect after cmux restarts.

rows.title: Custom Search Address
rows.help: Used when Search Engine is Custom. Put {searchTerms} where the typed text goes.

rows.title: Custom Suggestions Address
rows.help: Optional. Answers in the OpenSearch suggestions format, with {searchTerms} for the typed text.

rows.title: Browser Engine
rows.help: Browser tabs and cmux pages, such as History and Apps, open in this engine.

rows.title: Enable cmux Browser
rows.help: When off, cmux opens no browser tabs for web pages and every link opens in your default browser.

rows.title: Freeze Hidden Tabs
rows.help: Saves power: a hidden Chromium tab stops running until you show it. Pinned tabs and Never Hibernate hosts stay awake.

rows.title: Hibernate Hidden Tabs
rows.help: Frees memory; history and position are kept.

rows.title: Never Hibernate
rows.help: Hosts such as mail.google.com or *.example.com.

rows.title: Hosts to Open in Embedded Browser
rows.help: Only these hosts open in cmux, such as example.com or *.example.com. Empty opens every host in cmux.

rows.title: Offer to Import Cookies
rows.help: Browser tabs offer to import cookies from your other browsers, so you stay signed in. Nothing imports until you click Import. Don't Show Again on the banner turns this off.

rows.title: Import from Other Browsers
rows.help: Offers to bring bookmarks, history, passwords and sign-ins over from other browsers: Import from Browser in the File menu and the palette, and the import cards in Settings. Off hides them and nothing imports by itself. Data already imported stays.

rows.title: Keep Neighbor Tabs Awake
rows.help: Tabs on each side of the shown tab stay loaded and running, so switching to them is instant. 0 turns it off. Memory pressure and Low Power Mode turn it off.

rows.title: Command-Click
rows.help: In Chromium tabs, Download keeps Chrome's default.

rows.title: Shift-Command-Click
rows.help: Shift-middle-click does the same.

rows.title: Middle-Click
rows.help: Chromium tabs use the Command-Click setting.

rows.title: Option-Click
rows.help: Chromium tabs always download.

rows.title: Shift-Click
rows.help: In Chromium tabs, Download keeps Chrome's default.

rows.title: New Tab Page
rows.help: An address such as https://example.com. Empty opens a blank page.

rows.title: Address Bar Opacity
rows.help: How much the address bar covers a see-through window. At 0 it is as see-through as the window, but never so clear that its text stops being readable.

rows.title: Calculator Answers
rows.help: Shows the answer to arithmetic you type. Return copies it.

rows.title: Address Bar Corners
rows.help: Match Theme uses the standard bar radius. Capsule rounds the ends fully.

rows.title: Address Bar Text Size
rows.help: The size of the address and the suggestions. Match Density follows the density.

rows.title: Address Bar Glass
rows.help: The material of the address bar. Transparent draws no fill. Clear glass shows more of what is behind it. Off uses the flat theme color.

rows.title: Glass Tint
rows.help: The color over the glass, from the terminal theme. Accent is the theme's own accent color, or gray when the theme has none.

rows.title: Address Bar Height
rows.help: Match Density follows the density. The bar always grows to fit its text.

rows.title: Complete Addresses Inline
rows.help: Completes a site you typed before or visit often.

rows.title: Search Suggestions
rows.help: Sends what you type to the search engine for suggestions. Never addresses, files or local hosts.

rows.title: Address Bar Shadow
rows.help: A soft shadow under the glass address bar.

rows.title: Always Show Full URLs
rows.help: Shows the whole address, with https:// and www., when you are not editing it.

rows.title: Open Links in cmux Browser
rows.help: When off, links you click in terminals, agent chats, Home and cmux pages open in your default browser. Shift-Command-click opens a link in the other browser.

rows.title: Open Sign-In Pages in cmux Browser
rows.help: Sign-in and device-code pages, such as GitHub's device page or a page gh, aws or an agent opens to sign in, open in a cmux browser tab even when other links open in your default browser. URLs to Always Open Externally still win.

rows.title: Allow Password Export
rows.help: Lets the Passwords page write every saved password to a plain-text CSV file, after you confirm with Touch ID or your password.

rows.title: Suggest Strong Passwords
rows.help: Offers a generated password when a site asks for a new one, and saves it.

rows.title: Offer to Save Passwords
rows.help: A browser tab asks to save a sign-in you submit. Tabs an agent drives never ask.

rows.title: Open localhost on the Workspace's Machine
Search Engine
rows.help: The address bar searches here and asks it for suggestions.

rows.title: Show Agent Cursor
rows.help: When an agent drives a browser tab, show its cursor, clicks and typed keys on the page. Password fields show dots.

rows.title: Show Bookmarks Bar
rows.help: A row of bookmarks under each browser toolbar.

rows.title: Site Engines
rows.help: Sites that always open in one engine: a site, such as spotify.com, and chromium or webkit. Spotify, Netflix and other protected media sites open in WebKit, because their media does not play in Chromium.

rows.title: Toolbar Buttons
rows.help: Buttons shown next to the address bar. The rest are in the More menu, where Show in Toolbar pins them back.

rows.title: URLs to Always Open Externally
rows.help: Links that match open in your default browser. Text matches anywhere in the URL, * and ? are wildcards, and re: starts a regular expression.

rows.title: Fill Codes from Verification Emails
rows.help: When a site emails you a code or link, its tab offers it. Only on the sender's own site, never filled without your click, and never stored.

rows.title: Picture in Picture
rows.help: Offer Picture in Picture for a web page's video in menus, the command palette and the media controls. A site's own video controls are not affected.

rows.title: Route Subagents to the Best Agent
rows.help: The Chief picks the agent each subagent runs on, such as Codex for long coding work and Claude for writing and UI, even when the Chief itself runs on another. Off, subagents run on the Chief's own agent.

rows.title: Reaction Classifier Harness
rows.help: The agent harness the reaction classifier runs on, for example claude or codex. Empty uses the Chief's Claude route.

rows.title: Reaction Classifier Model
rows.help: The model that decides whether a reaction starts a turn. Claude Haiku by default: it is fast and cheap.

rows.title: Reaction Classifier Instructions
rows.help: What the classifier is told when it decides. Empty uses the built-in instructions.

rows.title: Reactions Can Wake the Chief
rows.help: A reaction you put on a Chief message can start a turn when it asks for one, such as a question mark on a question or a thumbs down on a plan. A cheap model decides first, so a reaction that needs no answer never shows the typing dots. Off, reactions are only noted.

rows.title: Send Hang Reports
rows.help: Nightly builds send a daily report of hangs and slow frames: call stacks of cmux and macOS code, timings, your app and macOS versions, your Mac's chip and memory size, and rounded counts of open windows and tabs. It never includes file names, web addresses, terminal text, names or anything you type. View Hang Report shows exactly what is sent.

rows.title: Keep Location in Photos and Videos
rows.help: When off, location data is removed from photos and videos before they are attached.

rows.title: Their Bubble Color
rows.help: Every chat starts with these colors. Right-click a chat and choose Chat Colors to set its own. Unset text colors are picked to stay readable.

rows.title: Their Text Color
rows.help: Every chat starts with these colors. Right-click a chat and choose Chat Colors to set its own. Unset text colors are picked to stay readable.

rows.title: My Bubble Color
rows.help: Every chat starts with these colors. Right-click a chat and choose Chat Colors to set its own. Unset text colors are picked to stay readable.

rows.title: My Text Color
rows.help: Every chat starts with these colors. Right-click a chat and choose Chat Colors to set its own. Unset text colors are picked to stay readable.

rows.title: Channels
rows.help: Show Channels below Home in the sidebar. You can also turn it on or off from the command palette.

rows.title: Bubble Style
rows.help: iMessage shows your messages in blue and the Chief's in gray. Theme uses your theme's accent and surface colors.

rows.title: Engine
rows.help: Which Chief Home opens. Auto uses this Mac's Chief while it runs here, else the Hosted Chief in the cloud.

rows.title: Show Chief Pet
rows.help: A small Chief floats over every app and shows agent events above it. Drag it anywhere; click it to message the Chief or reply to a session. While it shows, ⌃⌥⌘C opens its reply box from any app.

rows.title: Server
rows.help: Direct messages and group chats use cmux Cloud by default. A self-hosted server is reached over Tailscale by its MagicDNS name, for example http://mini.tail1234.ts.net:7320. No password is sent: the server knows you by your Tailscale login.

rows.title: Send System Shortcuts to the Remote Mac
rows.help: While a Mac Screen tab has the keyboard, shortcuts like ⌘Tab, ⌘Space, Mission Control and ⌘Q go to the other Mac. Needs Accessibility.

rows.title: Show Shortcuts When Holding a Modifier
rows.help: Hold Command or Control for 0.30 seconds to show shortcut hints.

rows.title: Send Agent Permission Requests to the Feed
rows.help: Each request's tool and command summary goes to your own cmux feed, so your iPhone can answer it.

rows.title: Connect GitHub
rows.help: Uses your gh login to read notifications and review requests on this Mac. Sign in with gh auth login first.

rows.title: Refresh Interval
rows.help: Seconds between GitHub refreshes. Refresh in the Inbox runs immediately.

rows.title: Copy Agent Notifications to the Feed
rows.help: Notifications from agents and cmux notify go to your cmux account's feed and can reach your iPhone.

rows.title: Copy Terminal Notifications to the Feed
rows.help: Notifications that programs send through the terminal can contain secrets. Off sends nothing to your cmux account.

rows.title: Ring Agent Chat Panes
rows.help: Ring an agent chat's pane when its turn ends, until you click or type in it.

rows.title: Flash the Pane When Read
rows.help: Clicking an unread pane, typing in it or jumping to it flashes its ring as it goes.

rows.title: Move the Workspace to the Top
rows.help: A notification moves its workspace to the top of the unpinned rows, unless you are looking at its pane.

rows.title: Bounce Dock Icon
rows.help: When a notification alerts while cmux isn't the active app.

rows.title: Quiet Hours
rows.help: No banners or sounds between these times.

rows.title: Show Message in Banners
rows.help: Whether a banner shows what the agent said, or only where and what state.

rows.title: Burst Cooldown
rows.help: Many notifications at once sound once. An agent asking for input still sounds. 0 turns it off.

rows.title: Volume
rows.help: Sounds cmux plays itself. A banner's default sound follows the system alert volume.

rows.title: Quiet After Typing
rows.help: A pane typed into this recently is marked read at once. 0 turns it off.

rows.title: Timeout
rows.help: Used when a source clears after a timeout.

rows.title: Notify When a Run Takes
rows.help: cmux status run notifies when the command took at least this long.

rows.title: Notify Even When the Terminal Is Visible
Allow iPhone Connections
rows.help: Lets the cmux app on your iPhone open this Mac's workspaces, terminals and agent chats while you are signed in with the same account.

rows.title: Terminal Size When Shared
rows.help: Decides the size of a terminal while this Mac and a phone show it at once. A device that gets a larger terminal than it fits scrolls sideways or shows empty space; text never wraps wrong. Set the priority order in the cmux app on your iPhone.

rows.title: Machine Color
rows.help: The color of each machine's sidebar rows and tab badges, by machine name: "#RRGGBB", or an accent name (red, green, yellow, purple, cyan, orange, pink, blue) that follows the theme. A machine without one gets a color from its name.

rows.title: New Cloud Workspaces Start In
rows.help: Current Folder copies the folder you work in (its whole git working copy) to the new machine. Empty Folder starts in the machine's own empty folder.

rows.title: Run New Workspaces in Cloud
rows.help: Each new workspace (Cmd-N, the sidebar's +) gets its own new Cloud machine. Agent chats you start in it run on that machine.

rows.title: Let Your Phone Use This Mac
rows.help: So your phone can find this Mac, cmux registers with its servers this Mac's name, device ID and platform, the app's bundle ID, version and build channel, the Mac's relay address and connection key, and your account and team IDs. Workspace names, folders, full paths and terminal output go only over the encrypted link to your phone. None of that, and no branch name or repo URL, is sent to cmux servers. Exception: while “Show This Mac's Workspaces on Your Phone While It's Off” is on, cmux servers store each workspace's ID, resource ID, short ID, name, name revision, group, color, icon, pinned state, unread mark, unread count and whether it is active.

rows.title: Show This Mac's Workspaces on Your Phone While It's Off
rows.help: cmux stores this Mac's workspace names, colors and unread counts so your phone can show them while the Mac is off. A workspace name can be a folder's name. No paths, tab titles or terminal output. Turning this off deletes the copy.

rows.title: Keep Mac Awake for Your Phone
rows.help: A sleeping Mac can't be reached from your phone until it wakes. Closing the lid still puts the Mac to sleep.

rows.title: Let Your Phone Start New Workspaces
rows.help: Off, your phone can still follow, type into and answer what's already running.

rows.title: Always Allowed SSH Link Hosts
rows.help: An ssh:// link from another app connects to these hosts without asking. Remove a host to be asked again. Saved machines and acpmux peers never ask.

rows.title: Classic Home
rows.help: Show Home as a full page instead of a workspace with the Chief docked on the left. Takes effect after cmux restarts.

rows.title: Join Any Machine with One Line
rows.help: Add Device shows a line to paste on any Mac or Linux computer; it joins your team's machines. Screen sharing and control stay off until that machine allows them.

rows.title: Show Preview Features
rows.help: Unfinished surfaces, such as the agent session's coverage label and Pull requests view.

rows.title: Voice Room
rows.help: An unofficial room where you talk with people and Chief. While a room is open, cmux transcribes your mic and reads your screen's text on this Mac, then sends that text to the room.

rows.title: Voice Room Address
rows.help: The room's web address. Empty uses the room server on this Mac.

rows.title: Device Hub Address
rows.help: Overrides the device hub this build signs its devices in to, for Mac Screen sharing between your devices. Leave it empty to use the built-in hub.

rows.title: Relay Only
rows.help: Mac Screen tabs connect through the TURN relay only, never directly, to check the relay path. Tabs that are connected reconnect.
